title: File exceeds 1000 lines (1560 lines total)
detail: At 1560 lines, this utility module mixes request-spec manipulation, group-detail resolution, resource aggregation, and global state management. Splitting into focused sub-modules would improve discoverability and reduce merge conflicts.

title: resources_from_request_spec: cyclomatic complexity 27, 67 lines
detail: CCN=27 is the highest in the scheduler subsystem. The function builds placement resource requests from a spec, branching on NUMA, CPU pinning, PCIe, memory encryption, and other dimensions. Each branch is a separate concern that could be extracted into a helper. High complexity here increases the risk of missed cases when new resource types are added.

title: _get_group_details: cyclomatic complexity 17, 49 lines
detail: CCN=17 for the function that resolves anti-affinity and affinity group membership. The many branches handle different policy types, cross-cell groups, and cache-miss recovery. Extracting per-policy-type logic would reduce complexity.

title: Inconsistent return statements in _get_group_details
detail: _get_group_details has code paths that return a value and paths that fall through to an implicit None return. Callers may not guard against None, leading to AttributeError. Make all return paths explicit.
